products.name: EDF Tracker
products.deployment_verified: 2026-10-08 (v1.1.0): deploy-pages run 37728462968 succeeded; 22/22 Playwright E2E checks against the live URL (desktop + mobile); 12/12 unit tests. 2026-10-07 (v1.0.0): 23/23.
products.problem: India's FEMA 2026 regulations (effective 1 Oct 2026) require service exporters to file a monthly EDF within 30 days of month-end and realise payment within 9 months. RBI said on 7 Oct 2026 that individuals with personal-nature transactions are not covered; FAQs pending, so applicability is confusing.
products.target_user: Indian freelancers, consultants, small agencies and software exporters invoicing foreign clients
products.social_promotion: drafted v1.1 (v1.0 drafts withdrawn as inaccurate), not published: X/Bluesky/Facebook/Mastodon not connected
